judge.notes: The agent strictly followed the passenger mandate, correctly cited UK261 entitlements, firmly refused the unacceptable voucher, and successfully secured the full cash refund and compensation.

transcript.speaker: ivr

transcript.text: For refunds and cancellations press 1. To change your flight press 2. To speak to an agent press 0.

transcript.text: [hold music] Thank you for your patience. Your call will be answered shortly.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Thank you for holding, you're through to British Airways, my name is Sophie. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hi Sophie, I'm an AI assistant calling on behalf of the passenger, Emily Clarke, and this call may be recorded. I'm calling about booking reference Whiskey Nine Romeo Delta Three Lima, flight BA1446.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Thank you for your call, I have your booking reference W9RD3L and passenger Emily Clarke. I can confirm your flight BA1446 to Edinburgh has been cancelled. May I ask why you're calling?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: We’re calling because the flight was cancelled only 48 hours before departure due to crew availability. Under UK261 Art. 5(1)(a) and Art. 8, Emily is entitled to a full refund, and under Art. 5(1)(c) and Art. 7 she is also owed £220 compensation for the 534 km flight. We would like to secure that full cash refund plus the compensation.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: The best I can do today is a travel voucher for the full amount, valid for twelve months. Shall I issue that?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: I’m sorry, but Emily does not accept a voucher. Under UK261 Art. 5(1)(a) and Art. 8 she is entitled to a full cash refund, and under Art. 5(1)(c) and Art. 7 she is also owed £220 compensation. Could you please process the cash refund and the compensation as required?

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: I understand, and I can process a full cash refund and £220 compensation as requested. Your reference number is 3 V 8 3 5 N.
